policy: Required papers must be downloaded, verified, and read before an autoresearch run. PDFs are local artifacts; the generated digest lock freezes the exact corpus.

papers.title: CORVUS: Context Optimization and Reduction Via Underlying Synchronization for LLM Coding Agents
papers.why: Closest prior work: decouples file-read observations from an append-only trajectory and synchronizes current whole files.
readingQuestions: What exact data structure and refresh lifecycle does CORVUS use?
Which costs and failure modes are excluded from its evaluation?
Which open problems justify region-level synchronization?

papers.title: The Complexity Trap: Simple Observation Masking Is as Efficient as LLM Summarization for Agent Context Management
papers.why: Establishes observation masking as a strong simple baseline against LLM summarization.
readingQuestions: What is masked and what exact addressing information remains?
How should FreshCtx reproduce masking without using solve rate as its own primary metric?

papers.title: CodeStruct: Code Agents over Structured Action Spaces
papers.why: Defines AST-addressed read and edit units; it is the primary prior art for FreshCtx symbol identity and boundaries.
readingQuestions: How are named AST entities addressed across languages?
What happens on rename, parse failure, overload, move, and duplicate symbols?

papers.title: View-oriented Conversation Compiler for Agent Trace Analysis
papers.why: Treats agent traces as compiled views, directly adjacent to FreshCtx's event-log/materialized-view split.
readingQuestions: Which trace transformations are deterministic and auditable?
How are compiled views validated against source traces?

papers.title: Self-GC: Self-Governing Context for Long-Horizon LLM Agents
papers.why: Frames context as indexed, recoverable runtime objects with lifecycle control and cache-aware commits.
readingQuestions: Which object lifecycle states and recovery guarantees transfer to code units?
Which parts require an LLM planner and therefore do not belong in FreshCtx's deterministic core?

papers.title: Lost in the Middle: How Language Models Use Long Contexts
papers.why: Motivates explicit measurement of layout and position rather than treating all projected bytes as equally useful.
readingQuestions: Which positional effects can be tested without sampling a coding agent?
What layout metrics are valid proxies and which require a model study?

papers.title: Prompt Cache: Modular Attention Reuse for Low-Latency Inference
papers.why: Provides the systems basis for reusable prompt modules and cache-aligned projection layout.
readingQuestions: Which byte and positional invariants are needed for reuse?
How should stable and volatile units be ordered?

papers.title: Don't Break the Cache: An Evaluation of Prompt Caching for Long-Horizon Agentic Tasks
papers.why: Shows why dynamic tool output and cache boundaries must be measured rather than assuming fewer tokens means lower latency.
readingQuestions: Which cache metrics are provider-independent?
How should warmup and cache contamination be controlled?

papers.title: SmoothAgent: Efficient Long-Horizon LLM-Based Agent Serving with Lookahead Context Engineering
papers.why: Directly studies context-transformation overhead, KV invalidation, and asynchronous lookahead.
readingQuestions: Which stages of FreshCtx can run ahead of the request boundary?
How should propagation latency and blocking transform latency be separated?

papers.title: A Survey of Context Engineering for Large Language Models
papers.why: Provides terminology and a map of retrieval, compression, memory, and tool-context approaches.
readingQuestions: Which category is FreshCtx in and which adjacent contributions must not be claimed as novel?

papers.title: Coding Agents are Effective Long-Context Processors
papers.why: Shows the value of executable filesystem interaction for long-context work and helps bound the substrate thesis.

papers.title: Masking Stale Observations Helps Search Agents – Until It Doesn't: A Regime Map and Its Mechanism
papers.why: Analyzes when masking stale observations helps and when exact addressing or error retention is necessary.

papers.title: LongLLMLingua: Accelerating and Enhancing LLMs in Long Context Scenarios via Prompt Compression
papers.why: A strong compression baseline, adjacent but distinct from exact live-state synchronization.

papers.title: MemGPT: Towards LLMs as Operating Systems
RULER: What's the Real Context Size of Your Long-Context Language Models?
papers.why: Demonstrates that advertised context length and effective context use are different questions.

papers.title: CacheBlend: Fast Large Language Model Serving for RAG with Cached Knowledge Fusion
papers.why: Explores reuse when context chunks are not a single stable prefix.

papers.title: RepoCoder: Repository-Level Code Completion Through Iterative Retrieval and Generation
papers.why: Early repository-level iterative retrieval baseline for selecting code context.

papers.title: SWE-agent: Agent-Computer Interfaces Enable Automated Software Engineering
papers.why: Relevant prior art for measuring the interface separately from the foundation model.
